description: A small cottage built from framed blocks with camos: stone brick base, oak plank walls, glass windows, a hip roof of framed slopes and corner slopes in dark oak and a brick chimney, seen from the front right at a low morning sun
Close-up of the cottage roof where the roof of the front wing meets the main roof: slopes, outer and inner corner slopes and the slope edge hoods over the windows
Eight different framed shapes as empty frames: slope, stairs, corner slope, double slope, pillar, panel, slab, vertical stairs
The same eight framed shapes with camos: oak planks, stone bricks, quartz, cherry planks, mossy cobblestone, copper, deepslate tiles, sandstone
A showroom of 48 different framed shapes on pedestals, all with a smooth quartz camo so that the geometry reads
Framed double blocks and divided blocks (double slope, double stairs, double corner, checkered, masonry, divided) with two contrasting camos each

The cottage at night, lit by framed lamp heads with glowstone, sea lantern and shroomlight camos and by framed blocks (windows, lamp heads, a stoop step, the chimney cap) made to glow with glowstone dust
Framed slabs, slopes, stairs, panels, corner slopes and cubes with a water camo (back row) and a lava camo (middle row) next to oak plank camos (front row)

Camo'd framed functional blocks: sign with text, item frame with an item, lever, buttons, wall torch, trapdoor, chest, flower pot, pressure plate, powered and detector rail slopes, door, fence gate and lanterns
The Framing Saw screen with empty framed cubes in the input slot and the slope recipe selected
The tools and utility items of the mod rendered large on a plain dark background: framed hammer, wrench, screwdriver, key, blueprint, reinforcement, phantom paste and glowstone dust
